categories.main_business_segments: UNID CO., Ltd. operates primarily in the chemical sector producing caustic potassium, potassium carbonate, and hydrochloric acid, alongside a power generation segment supplying steam and electricity. The company also has a forestry development and afforestation business. The chemical business is further supported by overseas subsidiaries in China focusing on chemical production and sales, while the power segment operates mainly in China.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes electrolysis technology for producing caustic potassium (KOH) with a concentration of about 30%, and chemical reactions involving CO2 for potassium carbonate production. Solid caustic potassium is produced using flaker drum equipment. Chlorine products are liquefied through compression and refrigeration processes. The power generation segment uses boilers and generators to produce steam and electricity. Continuous investments in facility upgrades, environmental improvements, and R&D for high-value and eco-friendly products are emphasized.
categories.primary_customers_markets: UNID serves industrial customers requiring basic inorganic chemicals such as synthetic rubber (SBR, ABS), semiconductors, pharmaceuticals, detergents, and solar wafer etching. The potassium products cater to battery, food additive, pesticide, and agricultural sectors. The power segment supplies steam and electricity primarily to industrial clients in China. The company also targets domestic and international markets, including North and South America, Europe, and China, with a focus on expanding export sales and high-value product segments.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates production facilities in South Korea (Ulsan) and multiple locations in China including Jiangsu Province (Jinjiang City, Taixing City), Sichuan Province (Guang'an City), Hubei Province (Yichang City), and Shanghai. Sales and distribution networks cover domestic Korean markets and international markets such as North America, Europe, and China. The power generation business is concentrated in Taixing City, China.
categories.supply_chain_position: UNID operates primarily in the midstream segment of the chemical supply chain, manufacturing basic inorganic chemical products from raw materials like potassium chloride (KCl) sourced mainly from Canada and China. It also operates downstream in power generation supplying steam and electricity to industrial customers. The company engages in product sales directly to end-users and through agents and distributors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes strengthening R&D capabilities and expanding facilities to develop eco-friendly, high-value-added, and new products. Current R&D focuses include low-density and fine potassium carbonate manufacturing technologies, impurity removal processes, and functional film development for electronic materials. Strategic investments are planned for expanding production capacity, especially in China, including a new potassium plant in Hubei Province targeting 2025 operation.
categories.revenue_model: UNID generates revenue primarily through the sale of chemical products such as caustic potassium, potassium carbonate, and chlorine derivatives, both domestically and internationally. The company also earns income from power generation by selling steam and electricity. Additionally, technology licensing fees are received from subsidiaries for production technology transfers. Sales are conducted via direct sales to end-users, agents, and distributors, with payment terms including cash, letters of credit, and bank guarantees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: UNID holds a dominant position as the sole domestic manufacturer of potassium-based chemical products in South Korea, facing partial competition from imports, especially from China. In China, subsidiaries compete in a fully competitive market but maintain advantages through large production capacity, quality control, and strategic geographic locations. The power generation segment faces limited competition due to the nature of steam supply networks and regional market characteristics.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, UNID reported consolidated revenues of approximately 1.13 trillion KRW, with a 19% decline from the previous year, and operating profit decreased by 78%. The company maintains a solid financial structure with a debt ratio of 39% and equity ratio of 72%. Despite recent profit margin declines due to raw material price drops and market conditions, UNID continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D to support future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: UNID emphasizes stable supply and rapid response to customer needs, leveraging its status as the only domestic producer of potassium chemicals to secure market dominance. The company focuses on high-quality, high-purity products, especially in high-value segments like electronic-grade potassium hydroxide. Its integrated production and sales network, combined with strategic overseas operations, enable competitive pricing and reliable delivery. The power segment offers stable steam supply with high reliability and regional exclusivity.
